item.subject: science
item.stem: During a school activity, Meena's teacher shows the class four places near their school in Jaipur and asks: which of these places can be called a habitat because an organism lives there and the place provides both living and non-living conditions needed for life? () A. An empty steel tiffin box kept in a cupboard, where no organism lives; B. The bark of a neem tree where ants and small insects live, and which gives them shelter, moisture and air; C. A clean glass bottle of drinking water sealed in the classroom, where nothing lives; D. A dry wall of the classroom with no plants or animals on it

options.A: An empty steel tiffin box kept in a cupboard, where no organism lives
options.B: The bark of a neem tree where ants and small insects live, and which gives them shelter, moisture and air
options.C: A clean sealed bottle of drinking water in the classroom, where nothing lives
options.D: A dry classroom wall with no plants or animals on it
